title: the house root reads its editable install's file URL as a path
assumption_check:
Load-bearing: pip writes direct_url.json's url as a file URL (Path.as_uri form). Measured: Measured 2026-11-14 on akiendell (Windows) at origin/main d6bebdfb7: direct_url.json holds file:///C:/automation/local/cairn; remote._house_root() answered C:\C:utomation\local\cairn against _CLASS_ROOT C:utomation\local\cairn (equal False), because url.removeprefix('file://') leaves '/C:/...'. So every client on Windows, the house's own included, is refused a replace of a stale live bus (3deafc9e36de), and BusStale names a path that does not exist. cairn/tools/bus_client/proofs/test_a_foreign_root_refuses_a_stale_live_bus.py tooth 1 reds on Windows on main: '/nonexistent/...' resolves to 'C:
onexistent\...'.
builder_check: D1: THE DECODE. cairn/tools/bus_client/remote.py _house_root reads the URL with urllib.parse.urlparse + urllib.request.url2pathname (which also decodes %XX), then resolves. D2: PROOFS. cairn/tools/bus_client/proofs/test_the_house_root_reads_its_file_url_as_a_path.py: the box's own checkout as Path.as_uri() reads back as itself; a scratch dir named with a space reads back with the space. D3: THE FIXTURE. cairn/tools/bus_client/proofs/test_a_foreign_root_refuses_a_stale_live_bus.py tooth 1 looks for the house root as resolved, so it holds on Windows.

bullets.text: The house root stripped file:// instead of decoding the URL, so on Windows no client matched it and BusStale named C:\C:\...
